info.name: SchooliAt Mobile App API - STUDENT
info.description:
Mobile app API only – STUDENT role. Run "Login as STUDENT" first, then run the rest.

All endpoints in this collection are for the mobile app (Android/iOS) and this role only. No web/admin endpoints.

Credentials: student5@gis001.edu | x_platform: android | Base URL: https://api.schooliat.com

request.description: Login as STUDENT. Saves token to {{auth_token}}. Run this first when testing this folder.

exec: var user = json && (json.user || (json.data && json.data.user)); if (user && user.id) { pm.collectionVariables.set('student_id', user.id); }

request.description: Saves IDs for use in later requests in this folder.

exec: var json = pm.response.json(); var d = json && (json.data || json); if (d && d.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('school_id', d.id);

request.description: Saves IDs for use in later requests in this folder.

exec: var json = pm.response.json(); var d = json && (json.data || json); if (Array.isArray(d) && d[0]) pm.collectionVariables.set('class_id', d[0].id);
